set.body: Implement PRD C-9 and X-1 through X-17 for matched similarity, repetition similarity, deterministic controls, temporal reinstatement, surface decomposition, and partial association. Relation is a sealed inspectable ADT; PairDesign encodes only legal directed and undirected spaces; PairwiseAnalysis retains both keys; reductions and failure policies are explicit; keyed bottom-k sampling is cap-monotone and cross-platform; task-named conveniences are thin facades over shared primitives. No Workflow hierarchy, opaque predicate core, invalid binomial mass regression, or cell-wise inferential statistics. PRD is normative.
